text:
nina: Quick question for the frequent flyers: what's your go-to trick for surviving a red-eye and arriving usable at an offsite? 
dave: Sleep mask + earplugs. Seriously. Put them on pre-board so your brain cues sleep. 
morgan: Also, drink water but avoid booze. And set your watch to destination time as soon as you board. tiny mental hack.
skye: Pack a tiny powerbank and a short braided USB-C cable in your pocket. Never trust airline seat ports.
travel-bot: Tip: If you plan to nap, choose the window seat to lean and avoid being bumped by aisles.
dave: Wear compression socks for long flights. Less swollen ankles = less groggy. 
nina: Any recs for white-noise apps that work offline?
morgan: I use "Noisy Plane" downloaded tracks. Also a 30-min guided nap playlist saved offline works wonders.
skye: Bonus: bring a collapsible travel pillow (inflatable) not the fuzzy neck roll. More support, less drool. 
dave: For conference mornings, dump a travel-size face wash and toothbrush in your backpack for a 5-min refresh in the bathroom. Instant human.
nina: Good call. Also adding travel kit: eye mask, earplugs, powerbank, short cable, travel toothbrush. Vote? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
morgan: :thumbsup:
skye: :thumbsup: Also let's add a spare universal adapter to the team bag for EU/UK trips.
travel-bot: Noted: items appended to "shared travel kit" list.
